Masterwork Assembly.name: Masterwork Assembly
Masterwork Assembly.description: Over about a minute the user builds a single large working machine or structure they have studied, part by part, straight from the skin: a truss bridge across a river or between rooftops, a pump that drains a flooded tunnel, a generator, a vehicle. It works for the rest of the scene and stays afterward, and a bridge made this way carries a whole evacuating crowd at once. Strain: severe.
